query: 人才储备与发展战略 人才储备与发展战略 衡量企业关键人才梯队的建设能力、核心岗位继任规划的成熟度。重点考察人才盘点机制、高潜人才储备计划、关键岗位的后备机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备完善的人才盘点机制（如九宫格评估）；针对所有关键岗位制定了明确的继任计划（含“即时/中期/长期”继任者）；建立了关键岗位风险监控与动态调整机制。 • 1分（合格）：建立了基础的人才库或管培生计划，有定性的继任规划描述，但缺乏系统的岗位风险评估或针对关键岗位的结构化继任名单。 • 0分（不合格）：无人才储备相关披露，或仅笼统提及“重视人才培养”。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：继任计划覆盖 >80% 的中高层管理岗位及关键业务/技术岗位。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对集团最高管理层，或未说明具体关键岗位的覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 人才盘点 继任计划 关键岗位 高潜人才 领导力梯队 九宫格 管培生 后备人才 9-box talent review succession planning key positions high-potential talent leadership pipeline 9-box grid management trainee bench strength 9-box 是否建立人才盘点机制（如九宫格）？ 是否有高潜人才储备或管培生计划？ 关键岗位是否有即时/中期/长期继任者安排？ 是否监控关键岗位空缺或继任风险？ 继任计划覆盖多少中高层及关键业务/技术岗位？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '人才储备与发展战略'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否建立人才盘点机制（如九宫格）？ 是否有高潜人才储备或管培生计划？ 关键岗位是否有即时/中期/长期继任者安排？ 是否监控关键岗位空缺或继任风险？ 继任计划覆盖多少中高层及关键业务/技术岗位？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“重视人才培养”；仅有培训课时统计；仅有校招宣传；仅有灵活办公制度；区分：人才储备与发展战略关注梯队与继任；受训百分比是培训覆盖统计；平等机会是选拔公平机制，三者证据不可互换。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Environmental, Social and Governance Report 2021 環境、社會及管治報告 2021 / Attracting the Talents
results.text: If the organisational structure and management system set up the structure for the operation of China SCE, then talent is the key to infuse the soul. The Group continued to expand its talent recruitment pipeline, and successively formulated and implemented the 'Recruiting Plan', 'Revitalising Water Plan' and 'Wind Catcher Plan' to accelerate the recruitment of mid-to-high-end talents. After the successful completion of the 'Thousand Talents in 3 Years' recruitment target initiated in 2017, the Group formulated the 'New 3-year Plan' this year and added the 'Brilliant Student' system to the existing 'Radiance Leader' and 'Enlightened Student' management trainee system, with the plan to reserve cadres for the frontline of the operational business to become the future backbone of the 'Two Wings'.

results.section: Environmental, Social and Governance Report 2021 環境、社會及管治報告 2021 / Training and Development
results.text: The formulation of the 'Talent Development Outline' sets out the key concepts for China SCE's talent development concepts and strategies. The Group is committed to providing equitable training and learning opportunities for its employees to support their career and personal development, thereby preparing them for future business challenges and opportunities. During the Year, the Group continued to provide a wide range of training activities, both online and offline, to employees at all levels, including 'Reaching for the Top' for senior staff to enhance their leadership skills, 'Pioneer Training' for the development of potential talents, and 'Spring Training' for different business units. As for new staff, the Group monthly conducts 'SCE Camp' training to help new recruits quickly understand the basic systems and acquire the necessary knowledge and skills to adapt to their new positions and integrate into the culture at China SCE.

[Content]
The formulation of the 'Talent Development Outline' sets out the key concepts for China SCE's talent development concepts and strategies. The Group is committed to providing equitable training and learning opportunities for its employees to support their career and personal development, thereby preparing them for future business challenges and opportunities. During the Year, the Group continued to provide a wide range of training activities, both online and offline, to employees at all levels, including 'Reaching for the Top' for senior staff to enhance their leadership skills, 'Pioneer Training' for the development of potential talents, and 'Spring Training' for different business units. As for new staff, the Group monthly conducts 'SCE Camp' training to help new recruits quickly understand the basic systems and acquire the necessary knowledge and skills to adapt to their new positions and integrate into the culture at China SCE.

As at December 2021, the Group's business covered 63 cities, with 25 new projects and a land bank of 38.23 million square metres ('sq.m.'). Looking ahead, the Group will continue to consolidate its regional leadership position and become a leading creator of a better lifestyle with a more proactive and stable development strategy.

results.section: Environmental, Social and Governance Report 2021 環境、社會及管治報告 2021 / Environmental, Social and Governance Approach
results.text: The Board takes full responsibility for the ESG development of China SCE and is committed to establishing a culture of good governance to safeguard the interests of stakeholders and respond to community expectations. With increasing social and international concern over the corporate ESG performance, the Board leads the Group's departments in developing, approving and implementing policies and measures to manage ESG issues in order to minimise the environmental and social impact of the Group's operations and to identify related risks at an early stage. The Board will also continue to enhance its involvement in ESG work, maintain regular meetings with management and review progress and effectiveness in order to establish a top-down governance model.
